gen-luckiest-guy-gf-funnel-sans: Luckiest Guy shouts cheerfully, its poured-looking letters all one width and its mean line set high. Funnel Sans sits beside it, tidy and level, like a deep breath after the laugh.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-gafata: Loud and cheerful, Luckiest Guy pours its letters in one unbroken line width. Gafata then takes over with a tall band of lowercase and wide-eyed e's, giving the loudness somewhere to rest.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-geist: Big, loud, and grinning from the first letter. Luckiest Guy's poured, single-width ink hands off to Geist, whose level beat turns words into solid blocks, and that quiet steadiness is what holds the two together.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-georama: Bright and shouty, Luckiest Guy draws every stroke at the same gauge, bowls included. Georama then settles in with a bracelet-wide c and low capitals, so a whole page of text would go down easily.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-gidole: Luckiest Guy hits like a cheerful shout, its poured-ink strokes all one width and its mean line set up high. Shared single-width strokes are the link: Gidole's neon-tube lines echo the shout.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-golos-text: Golos Text packs its lowercase tall into the line and parts its s wide, every stroke one width. And the mood gap is the draw: Luckiest Guy shouts cheerfully while the sans-serif text stays friendly.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Small letters that stand almost as tall as capitals, with a clear gap where the c ends, feel friendly. Hedvig Letters Sans sits next to Luckiest Guy's blueprint-lettering line like a quiet neighbor to a loud one.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-heebo: Heebo sets a tall central band of text, its curves stopping short instead of closing in on themselves. Under Luckiest Guy's round, unswelling bowls, paragraphs would move along smoothly.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-hind-guntur: Stamped-metal lowercase stands tall here, with wide gaps where curves meet stems and no thick-thin shift. Hind Guntur gives Luckiest Guy's cheerful shout a steady, sans-serif partner on the page.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-hind-madurai: Lowercase forms fill the line like capitals, with s curves opening wide at both ends and stroke ends cut from one ribbon. Hind Madurai sits under Luckiest Guy's loud, cheerful heading like a good-humored friend at its elbow.
